review_scope: Full three consumer modules, complete independent literal and32-test file; frozen32 vectors; shared range primitive/adapter/internal range public contracts and actual F03/F09/F10 dependencies inspected statically.

findings.finding: The shared adapter marks every field partial whenever whole-window coverage is incomplete. This contradicts frozen M12-02: suffixC180 and prefixO120 must remain observed using the authenticated original request spans. Current first base missing-opening case also loses C400.
findings.proposed_consolidated_resolution: Herschel: implement exact prefix/suffix coverage certification with endpoint price/history/finality safeguards, preserving H/L partial status; retain all existing frozen vector values.

findings.finding: A caller can construct/replace LocationSet or Location with arbitrary numeric geometry but the correct primitive and registered role/required_fields. object_members authenticates the source, not the formula output; shared writer checks only required fields. This permits forged derived scalar geometry to become eligible.
findings.proposed_consolidated_resolution: Add validated immutable result construction or a retained formula receipt/recomputation check covering generator/version/role/ratios/geometry/clocks/horizon/cap/semantic; include negative publication assertions. Coordinate with L01 owner because his consumer returns this type.

findings.finding: semantic prior_RTH is the default while prior_selection/current_instrument are optional. Several synthetic tests exploit that shortcut. PriorSessionSelection is also a public unchecked dataclass, so a caller can assert a false predecessor despite genuine primitive evidence.
findings.proposed_consolidated_resolution: Require authenticated Calendar prior relationship for a prior_RTH claim; retain explicit non-prior diagnostic semantics for unrelated windows. Validate or receipt-bind complete traversed known calendar rows/current/prior identity. Update the affected initial tests without changing frozen arithmetic.

findings.finding: Consumer availability validates source publication/session-known time but omits selection.selected_at and any later named-graph availability. primitive_registry_links authenticates provenance without enforcing a supplied decision cut. A later selected clock can therefore enter earlier measurement derivation. Direct ReferencePrice availability also omits raw instrument validity.
findings.proposed_consolidated_resolution: Validate selection.selected_at and all selection knowledge at decision/input cuts; enforce exact lifetime for direct reference availability and malformed typed inputs.

findings.finding: last_observed diagnostic is typed session_last_eligible_trade even when suffix coverage is missing; the reason string does not fix the semantic type. A provisional primitive can also set high/low observed_at to future formation end and raise instead of returning unsupported diagnostics. ReferenceSet has no tuple/type/order validation.
findings.proposed_consolidated_resolution: Use distinct observed-only last-trade type; keep unsupported provisional observation times absent or observed-prefix based; validate immutable ReferenceSet field order/types. Preserve certified session endpoint identity separately.

findings.finding: content_hash uses object_graph canonical serializer, which does not encode datetime.date. Hashing PriorSessionSelection recursively includes Session.trading_date and will fail, unlike Session.version/operations.digest.
findings.proposed_consolidated_resolution: Hash explicit supported date/version records or use the existing date-aware digest; add a real selected-prior version assertion.

findings.finding: Revision tests retain frozen candidate cuts but do not call actual ObjectGraph.object_asof for all frozen old/intermediate/new query times. L02-08 hardcodes its time switch in an assertion; L03-04 never creates the actual frozen target required by its vector.
findings.proposed_consolidated_resolution: Assert actual graph object_asof at230/239/240 and240/244/245; call bind_target/target before and after prior correction to prove target450 persists. Add corrected F09 and F10 joint restore comparisons, beyond current uncorrected CL04 restore.

findings.finding: CL02 counts a duplicated existing location as the14th item instead of the frozen unique extra_grid450 proposal. CL03 creates two Presentation values but does not execute all three frozen display-enabled variants or regenerate consumer results after the future suffix; it compares the same result object twice.
findings.proposed_consolidated_resolution: Materialize the exact unique extra proposal; evaluate all three frozen variants through the same immutable consumer request and compare actual regenerated identities/geometries/counts. Maintain no UI influence on core identity.

findings.finding: LocationSet.available honors horizon_end, but object_members discards explicit expiry except in a birth discriminator. Any caller graph with a different/absent TTL may retain eligible objects after that horizon. Tests manually choose matching TTL; the public publication path does not bind the horizon policy.
findings.proposed_consolidated_resolution: Bind and validate the graph expiry policy against explicit per-result horizon (or use a reviewed exact F10 expiry mechanism) before commit; assert actual candidate set unavailable at horizon. Keep source birth/revision stable across correction.

findings.finding: M12-11 only tests ReferenceGap and never asserts old-reference current-execution eligibility zero. L03-02 uses a direct synthetic ReferencePrice and no actual registry object retention/visit event; the vector explicitly retains one source object at both cuts. M12-08 likewise tests typed records but not their separate source publication/birth histories.
findings.proposed_consolidated_resolution: Strengthen these finite cases with actual certified/F10 source bindings and current-instrument rejection or retained-object assertions; keep official-message adapter synthetic and broader role models unavailable.

remaining: No pass/acceptance claim; findings await root whole-batch review and one consolidated repair.
Broader empirical/source mechanisms and E0 market-data dependencies remain open.
